decision: Reduce declared full tier after measured 2M configuration exceeds provisional installed budget; keep every other eligible identity as an explicit lead

format.compression: zlib level 6, at most 64 records, 8 MiB raw target
format.supplement: lean with full-wikitext fallback for empty broad notice candidates
format.index: contentless positional FTS5, reader_stopwords_v1 body, unchanged titles

estimate: Approximately 21 GB including aliases, based on exact full-text byte differences and measured first-shard index/compression costs; not a measured final total
policy: Actual whole-edition installed inventory must pass budget; preserve oversize evidence if it does not
acceptance: Host staging only; lower full count is an explicit adaptation, not achievement of original 2–3M target
